changes:
**New in Editing**
- **One Enter, one line.** One press of Enter now moves the caret and the text below by exactly one line, where it moved two: above several empty lines, at the start of a paragraph, and when pressed repeatedly inside a paragraph.
- **No extra empty line at a line break.** Enter at a line break inside a paragraph no longer leaves an extra empty line.

**New in Settings**
- **A click over the hidden part of the Font family list closes it.** When Settings have scrolled part of an open Font family list out of view, a click over that part now closes the list.
